# Mirror Maiden
Mirror Maiden's spring forth from reflections and the minds of those who look too deeply. They move through angles unseen to most and despise being seen. They have one clear motivation: end those who can see them.
## So I'm a mansus ghost?
Enjoy being a spooky ghost! Anyone with the appropriate faction icon (the little yellow screaming face) is mad and can see you, go beat em up. It's poor form to camp medical and prevent their revival. Your motivation is to end those who can see you. Dead people cannot see you. You are fine to mess around and haunt the crew as a wider whole. They messed up by shaping you into existence!
## So I'm seeing things?
So you delved too deep and got haunted. Well done. The best way of curing madness is mannitol and psychiatric meds from medbay. The chaplain can also bless you with his bible!
